import os,json,hashlib,unittest
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(Path(os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_PROFILE']).read_text())
b=Path(os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_BINARY']).resolve()
if hashlib.sha256(b.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=p['sha256']:raise ValueError('pair-guard-recipe-binary-mismatch')
os.environ['SWARM_TEST_BINARY']=str(b)
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests',pattern='test_local_pair_guard.py')
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
if result.testsRun!=12 or not result.wasSuccessful() or result.skipped:raise SystemExit('pair-guard-recipe-incomplete')
print('PASS local-pair-guard-12-named-tests '+p['sha256'])
